sample_identity: Exactly the 100 unique roots listed in the prior representative response-probe report.
checkpoint_split: Candidate-origin roots use candidate checkpoint; incumbent-origin roots use incumbent checkpoint.
root_actions: Best-visit regression and progress actions recovered from the saved root traces; no root search rerun.

visit_instrumentation.root_visit_total_validation: Every completed continuation search must sum to the requested simulation budget.
visit_instrumentation.historical_report_warning: Visit fields in post_wall_pawn_regression_deeper_4ply.json and its CSV are invalid because they summed normalized policy probabilities; final values and move choices remain usable.

continuation.search: Fresh vanilla PUCT tree at each continuation ply; root noise, progressive widening, category balancing, category exploration, repetition penalty, and pawn progress bonus disabled.
continuation.repetition_condition: Vanilla condition disables full-state repetition filtering at every continuation ply; repetition-avoidance condition enables it at every continuation ply using reconstructed chronological state history.
continuation.move_selection: Highest root visit count after the fixed MCTS budget.
continuation.evaluation: Unchanged matching checkpoint, converted to the original root player's perspective; terminal outcomes use exact win/loss values.
continuation.paired_branches: Regression and progress start from the exact same root state, checkpoint, search condition, and continuation budget.

interpretation: Multi-ply fixed-budget MCTS continuation diagnostic, not exhaustive minimax or proof of optimal play.
